qa_pairs.question: What special tool is needed to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 23 1 050 is needed to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: What important step must be done before pressing the set when engaging reverse gear?
qa_pairs.answer: Engage reverse gear by moving sliding sleeve forward before pressing the set.

qa_pairs.question: What should be placed between the claws and sealing surface to avoid damage?
qa_pairs.answer: Use a piece of wood, aluminum or similar material between claws and sealing surface to avoid damage on sealing surface.

qa_pairs.question: What components should be checked during installation and replaced if necessary?
qa_pairs.answer: Check condition of all bearings, replacing if necessary.

qa_pairs.question: What is step 9 in the procedure shown in the diagrams?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove lock in socket of bolt and unscrew bolt (9). The procedure includes sealing between case and bolt.

qa_pairs.question: What components are removed along with the reverse gear shaft?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove reverse gear shaft, reverse gear, needle bearing and thrust washer.

qa_pairs.question: What is removed in step 10 according to the procedure?
What should be checked regarding the operating lever during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Check installed position of operating lever (1).

qa_pairs.question: What special tools are used to pull the shafts into the case rear section?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull input shaft, output shaft and layshaft into case rear section with Special Tools 23 1 300 and 23 2 150.

qa_pairs.question: What must be ensured about the selector components during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Make sure selector rods, selector shaft and layshaft do not clamp while pulling in.

qa_pairs.question: What gear positions should be set during the installation process?
qa_pairs.answer: Place input shaft and output shaft with 1st/2nd gear selector rod, 3rd/4th gear selector fork, 5th/reverse gear selector rod and selector shaft as well as layshaft in case rear section.
